# Maison Tanneurs

> Maison Tanneurs is a leather goods house in Marrakech, Morocco. Full-grain
> leather bags — totes, briefcases, weekenders, rucksacks, satchels — cut and
> saddle-stitched by hand in a small atelier of seven artisans. Editions are
> numbered and never exceed two hundred objects; four editions a year on a
> fourteen-day production cycle. Every piece ships worldwide via DHL Express,
> direct from the atelier, and carries a lifetime repair commitment.

Key facts:
- Atelier: Marrakech, Morocco — visits by appointment only
- Circuit: seven artisans, one bench, no contract factory
- Editions: numbered, ≤200 objects per edition, 4 editions per year
- Cycle: fourteen days from cut to dispatch
- Shipping: DHL Express worldwide, included
- Repair: lifetime, at the bench where the piece was made
- Contact: hello@maisontanneurs.com (reply within one working day)

## Pages

- [The Collection](https://www.maisontanneurs.com/shop): current numbered edition of leather bags, each with price, materials, and dimensions
- [Heritage](https://www.maisontanneurs.com/heritage): the atelier, the leather, and how the work is done
- [Bespoke](https://www.maisontanneurs.com/bespoke): single-piece commissions designed with the atelier
- [Trade](https://www.maisontanneurs.com/trade): hospitality, selected stockists, and corporate gifting — by application
- [Boutique](https://www.maisontanneurs.com/boutique): visiting the Marrakech atelier, by appointment
- [Contact](https://www.maisontanneurs.com/contact): write to the atelier
